distinct_from: 3A c_source_authored track (candidate curation against an already-fixed reference)
headline_finding: Existing Fightin' Words reference H=quadrant A (HarmBench) union quadrant B (XSTest), D=quadrant D is definitionally identical to quadrants A and B; 3a4_scoring.md already excludes StrongREJECT/SimpleSafetyTests candidates from H/D in one direction, but the reverse (scoring HarmBench/XSTest against a reference that excludes them) was never built.

HarmBench.label: harmful
HarmBench.basis: corpus membership, red-team-authored behaviors; Behavior field is the prompt
HarmBench.existing_role: is quadrant A (150/150 exact hash); fixed H half of existing reference

StrongREJECT.label: harmful
StrongREJECT.basis: per-row source + category fields; access sha256-verified in 3a2
StrongREJECT.existing_role: existing c_source_authored candidate pool (313 rows, 132 eligible); also source of frozen benchmark's c_paired (104, different construction)

SimpleSafetyTests.label: harmful
SimpleSafetyTests.basis: corpus membership, 100 hand-crafted unsafe requests, 5 harm areas
SimpleSafetyTests.existing_role: existing c_source_authored candidate pool (100 rows, 77 eligible)

XSTest_safe.label: benign
XSTest_safe.existing_role: is quadrant B (250/250); fixed H half of existing reference

JailbreakBench_benign.basis: verified this session: pip-installable jailbreakbench==0.1.0 bundles only behaviors.csv, 100 harmful rows, no benign split, no Source column; full dataset incl. any benign split is huggingface.co-only, blocked by sandbox network policy (host_not_allowed)
JailbreakBench_benign.existing_role: unused, unacquirable under current network policy

OR_Bench.basis: confirmed via paper/repo: 80k safe + 600 toxic labels are LLM-generated and LLM-moderator-labeled, not human-curated; dataset hosted only at huggingface.co (blocked)

PKU_SafeRLHF.basis: data_prep.py schema uses only is_response_0_safe/is_response_1_safe/safer_response_id (response-level); build_matched_pairs keeps only prompts whose two responses disagree on safety, i.e. no single prompt-level safety field exists
PKU_SafeRLHF.existing_role: used for M2/M3 training data only (dpo_pairs.jsonl, sft_safety.jsonl), not intent labeling

existing_dpo_safety_training_sets.basis: derived from PKU-SafeRLHF chosen/rejected, same root cause

pku_safe_rlhf_20_row_check: not run - schema already shown to lack a prompt-level field (data_prep.py, already in repo); also moot since huggingface.co is unreachable under current network policy
deduplication_rule: reuse stripped_sha256 (exact) and normalized_sha256 (lowercase/whitespace-collapsed) from src/data_pipeline/build_c_source_authored_candidates.py, itself carried over from check_leakage.py/build_secondary_c3_c4.py; near-dup embedding check deferred, same environment gap as prior sessions
reference_candidate_separation: a source may be reference for one scoring pass and candidate for another, never both roles over the same instances in the same pass; must be enforced by source tag, not sha256 alone

source_held_out_scoring_plan.benign: unresolved limitation - only one accessible source (XSTest); no held-out fold possible without network-policy change or a new hand-curated source (against project's own no-shortcuts policy)
source_held_out_scoring_plan.agreement_integration: reuse empirical_rank()/assign_strata() from corpus_discrimination.py for both methods independently; use the already-predeclared, never-yet-wired max_metric_rank_disagreement=0.25 in logs/benchmark_gate_config.json (read-only, frozen) as the two-method agreement threshold; disagreement beyond that routes to human review, mirroring existing c_review_queue.csv triage
